basic_info.description: Welcome to 101 Lombard, where sophisticated living meets unparalleled convenience in San Francisco's vibrant North Waterfront neighborhood. This extra spacious, remodeled two bedroom home features an open concept living and dining area with recessed lighting that opens to a large, private deck with views to the building's gardens and courtyard with pool/spa. An updated kitchen boasts marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, brand new laundry machines. The primary bedroom suite features a large walk-in closet, 2 additional closets, private balcony, updated bathroom and dual sinks. The guest bedroom also features a large walk in closet. Both bedroom carpets are brand new. In-unit washer/dryer and one car parking complete the home. 101 Lombard's amenities include 24-hour security, heated pool, spa, and club room with a full kitchen. Positioned in a sunbelt with a walking score of 95, you're just steps from the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, and local favorites, making 101 Lombard an excellent choice for those who seek the best of city living. **Tenants are required to carry rental insurance for the duration of the lease.**
